en: Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a broad river with fast-moving water and floating logs, surrounded by forested hills. A small industrial complex or power facility stands on the left bank near rapids or a waterfall. In the foreground is open grassy land with scattered trees and power poles. Printed caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom edge identifying the view, and a photographer/publisher logo is in the lower right corner.
